about.title: Elk Grove Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: After a sudden death in Elk Grove, the questions arrive faster than the answers. Sacramento County records for 2025 list 10 traffic deaths inside the city, with the highest collision counts on corridors residents drive every day: Elk Grove Boulevard, Laguna Boulevard, Bruceville Road and Sheldon Road. Fatal harm is not limited to the road, though. A fall on an unsafe property, a defective product, or a preventable medical error can also support a wrongful death claim. California treats these as civil actions, wholly separate from any criminal charges the district attorney may or may not pursue. Standing to sue belongs first to a surviving spouse or domestic partner and children, then to certain dependents and heirs. The filing window is generally two years from the date of death, and it shrinks considerably when a city, county, or state agency is involved. LawProactive is not a law firm. We are a free service that pairs Elk Grove families with an independent attorney who takes wrongful death cases on contingency, so no fee is owed unless there is a recovery.

items.question: There is a criminal case in Sacramento County against the driver. Do we still need a civil claim?
items.answer: Yes, the two proceed on separate tracks. A criminal case is brought by the prosecutor and is about punishment, while a wrongful death action is brought by the family to recover its own losses. One can move forward regardless of how the other ends, and the two-year civil deadline keeps running during the criminal process.

items.question: What if the crash involved a city vehicle or a poorly maintained road in Elk Grove?
items.answer: Claims against a city, Sacramento County, or the state follow a different and much shorter procedure than a claim against a private driver. A formal government claim usually must be submitted within months, not years, before any lawsuit can be filed. Because of that, families in this situation should speak with an attorney as soon as they are able.

items.question: Who is allowed to bring a wrongful death claim in California?
items.answer: The law gives priority to the surviving spouse or registered domestic partner and the children of the person who died. If none exist, certain dependents and heirs may have standing instead. An attorney can review your family's situation and explain who should be included so the claim is not challenged later.
